verdict.rationale: The evidence shows event-notification mechanisms rather than generic webhooks. Budget alerts can publish to Pub/Sub topics (docs-21, docs-9), and Personalized Service Health offers custom alerts and API data for incidents (docs-17). Nothing documents subscribing an HTTP endpoint as a webhook. Missing for 10: explicit webhook/HTTP push subscription documentation, a general-purpose event catalog beyond budgets and service health, delivery/retry/signing details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
